name: Insert Sequence
summary: Multi-caret sequence insertion (numbers · letters · dates · lists · templates) as a prompt extension — same engine as the built-in, replaces it when installed (WASM · ABI v1.2)
description:
The Insert Sequence feature (Edit ▸ Insert Sequence…, Ctrl+Alt+N) as a WASM extension built on the ABI v1.2 'prompt transform' API: the app keeps the live prompt, the multi-caret regions, the replace / restore / undo handling, and this extension only turns the expression you type into n values (same nsql-seq engine as the built-in, so the syntax is identical: start[+-*^step][#repeat][~format] [* list] ["template"] — type ? in the prompt for the cheat sheet).
Installing it replaces the built-in Insert Sequence (same id); removing it brings the built-in back. ext.insert_sequence.default (Preferences ▸ Extensions ▸ Insert Sequence) is the expression used when the prompt is empty.
It is also the reference sample for writing your own prompt extension (extensions/sdk/samples/insert-sequence): declare prompts in the meta and implement transform.
0.1.1: the Cartesian product separator is now * (as in [A,B]*[1,2]); x and × still work.
author: SosomLab

messages.install: Insert Sequence (WASM) is installed and replaces the built-in: Edit ▸ Insert Sequence… or Ctrl+Alt+N with several carets · ? in the prompt shows the cheat sheet.
